description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quad Element Mode III (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water)] and [Crystal's Revelation Mode] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Quad Element Mode III (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Earth/WInd/Water ability

description.name: Crystal's Revelation Mode
description.text: ATK +70%, DEF -50%, casts Tremendous Slash after using Swift Hit or Onion Knight's Dance, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode], grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] to the user when removed
